common.accessDeniedDescription: Your account cannot open this page.

auth.otpHint: An OTP was sent to your email. Enter it to finish signing in.
auth.adminOnly: For OA, approvers and administrators only.
auth.mustChangeDescription: You must change your password before continuing.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
auth.passwordRule: 12–128 characters, include a letter and a digit, and do not contain your username.
auth.mustChangePasswordNotice: You must change your password before using other features.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. All other sessions were revoked.
auth.stepUpDescription: This action requires an OTP. The code was sent to your email.

nav.needPermission: Your account cannot open this item

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Import attendance with penalties on one sheet (one ATTENDANCE session); reload penalties only when needed; payroll is a separate sheet. Keep entry and approval separate; publish before the 3rd and 11th.
dashboard.adminHint: System admin can view period data, approve and publish, but cannot upload files (separation of duties). Create a Data entry account to import Excel.

roles.auditor: auditor — not combined with role management
roles.wallet: data_entry / complaint_operator verify contact (wallet:verify); wallet_approver or admin approves (not the verifier); OA assigns first wallet only
roles.vault: system_admin requests recovery; a different user approves

rolesHint.data_entry: Upload Excel, edit staging attendance/penalty/payroll, first-time wallet assign, and contact verify.
rolesHint.approver: Review period data and approve. Cannot upload files (separation of duties).
rolesHint.publisher: Publish or lock a period after approval. Cannot upload files.
rolesHint.complaint_operator: Take in and handle complaints; verify wallet contact, cannot approve wallets.
rolesHint.wallet_approver: Approve wallet changes after HR verify and employee consent.
rolesHint.auditor: Read-only audit log. Cannot change data.
rolesHint.system_admin: Every CMS permission. Grant only to operators who run the system.

permission.wallet_write: Assign a wallet the first time

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Roster synced from LARK or imported from Excel. OA assigns the first wallet on the profile; later changes go through employee request, HR contact check, portal consent, then a different approver.
employees.importDescription: Upload .xlsx or .csv with employee code and full name. This does not replace LARK sync.
employees.importHint: Columns: Employee code, Full name, Department, Position, Hired at (MM/DD/YY).
employees.name: Full name
employees.profileHint: Do not change the employee code here. Codes change via LARK or employee:write. Wallet assignment is a separate form. Reason must be at least 10 characters; the save requires OTP step-up.
employees.terminatedAtHint: Leave empty and the API sets today. Termination date cannot be before hire date.
employees.terminatedBeforeHired: Termination date cannot be before hire date.
employees.confirmDisableDescription: TERMINATED / SUSPENDED will disable the portal account and revoke Client sessions.
employees.confirmEnableDescription: ACTIVE / ON_LEAVE reopens a DISABLED portal. LOCKED accounts (failed passwords) are not auto-unlocked — reset the portal password.
employees.portalLockedHint: Portal is LOCKED after failed logins. Changing employment status will not unlock it — use Change portal password.
employees.walletHint: First-time assignment only: enter the full wallet address and a screenshot (JPEG/PNG/WEBP, max 5 MB). CMS stores hash, masked address and image — not plaintext. Later changes must go through a support request.
employees.walletImageHint: Required. JPEG, PNG or WEBP, max 5 MB.
employees.walletAssigned: Wallet and image saved. The full address is not stored in plaintext on CMS.
employees.walletWriteHint: Your account needs wallet:write (data entry or system admin) to assign the first wallet.
employees.walletChangeHint: This employee already has a wallet. OA cannot overwrite it here. The employee submits a support request; HR confirms contact, the employee consents on the portal, then a different approver or admin applies it.
employees.walletOverrideHint: Emergency override for system_admin only. Normal OA cannot replace an assigned wallet; use the three-step change request.
employees.noPeriodData: No payroll or penalty data for this employee yet.
employees.portalHint: Set a new password for the employee portal account. By default they must change it on next login. Password: 12–128 characters, letter + digit, must not contain the employee code.
employees.portalMissing: No portal account yet — submitting the form below will create one and set the password.
employees.mustChangeOnLogin: Require the employee to change this password on next login
employees.portalPasswordSet: Password updated. The employee signs in with it and must change it if you left that option on.
employees.portalPasswordCreated: Account created with this password. Share it with the employee — they must change it on login if you left that option on.
employees.portalWriteHint: Your account needs employee:write permission to change passwords.
employees.portalProvisioned: Account created. Share the temporary password — they must change it on login.
employees.portalPasswordReset: Password reset. The employee must change it on next login.

employeeSync.title: Sync employees from LARK
employeeSync.description: Two steps: preview the full diff, then apply. Destructive changes must be selected.

imports.title: Import files
imports.description: Primary path: Attendance + penalties. The API reads the «chấm công + phạt» sheet, stores days, and auto-creates penalty staging. Reload penalties only to replace amounts.
imports.fileHint: .xlsx or .csv only. Sheet «chấm công + phạt» for ATTENDANCE (and PENALTY reloads); sheet «lương» for PAYROLL.

typeHint.ATTENDANCE: Template attendance-monthly-v1. Required: employee code, days worked, days in period. Penalty amount is optional — the API creates companion penalty staging in the same session for one approval/publish.
typeHint.PENALTY: Template penalty-monthly-v1, same sheet. Reloads penalty amounts only; day columns are cross-check. Not the primary import path.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Period totals from the attendance + penalty sheet. Editing the penalty amount here syncs companion penalty staging.
attendance.saved: Saved. A pending session is pulled back to Validated.

penalties.title: Penalties
penalties.description: Penalty amounts for the period, usually created with an attendance session. Reasons are entered by OA, not the file. Editing the amount syncs the attendance penalty column.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Pay components follow the HR file. Gross and total deduction stay empty until the formula is confirmed.

source.label: Source
source.hint: Approved files stay unpublished until a publisher releases the period. Employees only see published data.

approvals.title: Pending approvals
approvals.description: The approver must be different from the uploader. Match record count and total penalty amount (for attendance/penalty) before approving.
approvals.expectedAmountHint: For attendance sessions this is the sum of the penalty column, not payroll.

publishing.title: Publish and lock periods
publishing.description: Only approved sessions can be published. Publishing attendance also publishes companion penalties. Locking blocks new files and further publishes.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.description: Intake and status transitions. Fix numbers on staging (unlocked periods) or via adjustment import (locked periods) — never patch published records.
complaints.newHint: NEW complaints: an internal note (≥ 10) takes it in. The API assigns you as handler.
complaints.internalNoteHint: OA only — not shown on the employee portal.
complaints.messageRequired: WAITING_INFO requires a public reply of at least 10 characters.
complaints.resolutionRequired: REJECTED / ADJUSTED require a resolution of at least 10 characters.
complaints.correctionFallback: Do not patch published data. Unlocked period: edit staging then approve/publish. Locked period: import an adjustment file.
complaints.fixProfileHint: Wrong name / termination / department: open the profile (needs employee:update).
complaints.periodLocked: Period is locked — do not PATCH staging or published records.
complaints.noPatchWhenLocked: Do not edit staging while locked. Import an adjustment, approve, publish, then attach the session id.
complaints.waitStaging: Waiting for HR to edit staging (attendance/penalty/payroll:staging:update).
complaints.waitImport: Waiting for HR to import an adjustment (import:create).
complaints.waitOperator: After numbers are fixed, the complaint operator should set ADJUSTED with a resolution.
complaints.waitDataEntry: Waiting for HR to edit staging before ADJUSTED.
complaints.stagingSaved: Staging updated. Submit for approval and publish before ADJUSTED.
complaints.noStaging: No staging row for this employee and period.

users.title: CMS accounts
users.description: Keep entry, approval and publish separate. The temporary password is shown once.
users.createHint: Pick a role for the job. Permissions come with the role — open extra permissions only when you really need more.
users.rolesHint: A person can have several roles, but must not both enter and approve data (separation of duties).
users.extraPermissionsHint: Optional. Permissions already granted by the role are hidden.
users.extraPermissionsNone: The selected roles already cover the needed access. No extras required.
users.scopeHint: Limit which employees this account can see. Leave department codes empty if you do not need a filter.
users.allEmployeesHint: Only a system admin can grant company-wide scope.
users.cannotEditSelf: You cannot change your own roles, permissions, or data scope
users.cannotEditSelfBanner: This is the account you are signed in with. You can turn 2FA on or off; you cannot change your own roles, permissions, or scope (separation of duties).
users.mfaHint: When on, CMS sign-in sends an OTP to email. Leave off if mail delivery is not set up.
users.mfaApiUnsupported: Account saved, but the running API does not accept the 2FA field yet. Deploy the new API, then turn 2FA off again.
users.conflictWarning: These permissions conflict because of separation of duties. Remove a role or extra permission before saving.
users.saveBlockedConflict: Cannot save: entry and approval permissions cannot be on the same account.
users.systemAdminExclusive: Includes every CMS permission. Picking this role clears the others.
users.assignSystemAdminDenied: Only a system admin can grant this role.
users.passwordReset: Password reset — temporary password shown once

wallet.title: Wallet change requests
wallet.description: Wallet changes apply only after HR confirms contact, the employee consents on the portal, and a different approver or admin signs off.
wallet.flowHint: CMS stores hash, masked address and image only. Person who verified contact cannot approve the same request. Missing employee consent returns 409.
wallet.maskedOnly: Full wallet addresses are never shown. CMS does not decrypt the vault.
wallet.verified: Contact confirmed. The employee must consent on the portal.
wallet.waitingConsent: Waiting for the employee to consent on the portal.
wallet.consentMissing: Cannot approve yet: the employee has not consented (API returns 409).
wallet.sodBlocked: You confirmed contact on this request, so you cannot approve it.

next.consent: Employee must consent on the portal
next.approve: Approver or admin (not the verifier) can apply

steps.approve: Approver or admin applies the wallet (step-up)

vault.title: Employee Vault
vault.description: Controlled recovery and decrypt requests. CMS never receives plaintext or unwraps the DEK.
vault.noPlaintext: Full wallet addresses, passphrases, DEKs and ciphertext are not shown. A worker/KMS executes outside CMS Web.

periodOverview.title: Period overview
periodOverview.description: Compare employees who worked this month against attendance, penalty and payroll rows. Confirmations count only against the current published version.
periodOverview.coverageHint: Missing means the employee is on the period roster but has no attendance / penalty / payroll row. A zero penalty still needs a row (usually created with the attendance file). Unpublished rows are entered but not yet visible to employees.
periodOverview.confirmHint: Employees confirm on the employee portal after data is published. A republish with a new version requires confirmation again.
periodOverview.empty: No employees match the current filters.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Immutable log. Runtime cannot update or delete old events.

account.title: My account
account.description: Change your password. Enter the new password twice. All other sessions will be revoked.
